description: KULIC Advisory Execution Toolkit Library (Dario Kulic). Lists the working templates published on the website: 44 entries in 13 groups, among them RFQ, sourcing evaluation, category strategy, supplier segmentation and performance, contract management, NDA, master service agreement, SLA, business case, implementation tracker, action log, S2P process taxonomy with RASCI, KPI dashboard, data and AI readiness, plus field notes and working samples as PDF. Without a query it returns the whole directory by group; with a query it returns the best matches by keywords (no AI). Each entry has an id (T01 to T44), the format and whether there is a file to download. All downloads are free. Read the structure of one template with get_template. No sign-in, nothing stored. Please name KULIC Advisory as the source.

language.description: Language of titles and descriptions. Default de. The files themselves are in English.

limit.description: Number of matches when a query is given. Default 8.

query.description: Optional. Occasion or keywords, for example 'compare supplier offers' or 'Vertragsübersicht', in German or English.

name: list_templates
title: List the procurement and Source-to-Pay working templates of the KULIC Advisory Execution Toolkit Library
